description: New. The state the active traveler page polls every 30 seconds (spec 125 FR-026). Read-only. It returns no saved values: a client fetches GET /travelers/:id/data/ only for an input whose revision changed.
auth: Session (auth.ensureAuthenticated), then reqUtils.canReadMw('id'). Same as GET /travelers/:id/ncr-links/.

inputs.name: string
inputs.label: string
inputs.revision: string — changes exactly when the saved value changes
inputs.options: ['input', 'initiate_ncr'] when status is 1, otherwise []; 'input' is absent when waiting_on_ncr

200.submit_ready: boolean — open_ncrs and missing_inputs are both empty

responses.403: No read access to the traveler (canReadMw).

semantics.poll_interval: 30 seconds, from the active traveler page only (FR-026, FR-031). Paused while the tab is hidden (FR-030).
semantics.failures: The client keeps its last state and retries at the next tick. No error message per failed poll (FR-029).
